periods.analysis: Q1 actions: Published six anti-stigma messages and hosted five community conversations, mostly in Harbor Creek and North Inlet. Recorded interviews for a resident story series, but editing is behind schedule. Partners: Faith partners, United Way of the Harbor Region.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Finish the resident story videos and schedule conversations with schools.

periods.analysis: Q2 actions: Finished editing three resident video stories, though release slipped to summer. Held eight community conversations, three with schools. East Flats and Seagrove have seen few messages because translated versions are not ready. Partners: Harborview Unified School District, faith partners, United Way of the Harbor Region.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Release the three video stories, raise school-partnered conversations to six, and keep publishing monthly messages.

periods.analysis: Q3 actions: Published 12 public messages, including three resident video stories, and hosted 11 community conversations, six of them in partnership with schools. East Flats and Seagrove audiences have seen the fewest messages so far, which slowed progress. Partners: Harborview Unified School District, faith partners, United Way of the Harbor Region.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Translate the video series and screen it at East Flats and Seagrove community nights, and measure message recall with a short pulse survey.
